title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Larch is a startup building travel apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Eastmere.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go. You will build offline-first features, review code with the team and improve app performance and stability.

Flexible hours. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
